description: Score tree test (findability) data. Give `results` as CSV with a header row and one row per participant per task, with columns task, success (yes/no or 1/0), and optionally direct (reached the answer without backtracking), first_click (the top-level label clicked first), time (seconds). Optionally `expectedFirstClicks` as lines 'Task name = Label, Label'. Returns per task: participants, success rate with 95% Wilson interval and a band (80+ strong, 60 to 79 mixed, under 60 weak, our rule of thumb), directness, direct-success rate, first-click distribution and the share on expected labels, median time, and notes (small sample, success that needed backtracking, wrong first clicks). Reports skipped rows rather than failing.

results.description: CSV text (or an array of row objects) with columns task, success, direct, first_click, time

name: tree_test_scorer
title: Tree test scorer
